record.one_liner: SE Ranking is an SEO and AI-search visibility platform covering keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, site audits and competitor analysis.
record.auth_notes: Data API key is sent as `Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY` (or an `apikey` query parameter, which is discouraged). The key is copied from Settings > API. The hosted MCP server also supports OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, but I found no documented OAuth flow for third-party apps on the REST API. API keys have full account access, and read-only keys aren't available yet.
record.access_notes: The API page says API access is included in every plan (Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo). A free trial account can test the API with no credit card. There is a pay-as-you-go option with a $50 minimum deposit, and an API add-on from $149/mo. The page also links a "100K free credits" offer whose terms I did not verify. Pricing is from the marketing page and I did not check it against the pricing page. Cheapest ongoing access is likely pay-as-you-go at $50, not confirmed beyond the API page.
record.blocker: There is no free tier. Access needs a trial, a paid plan, or a $50 pay-as-you-go deposit. API keys are full-account with no read-only scope. Default rate limits are low and I did not see the actual numbers. Sub-accounts can't use OAuth on MCP. There is no documented OAuth for third-party REST apps, so users must paste in their own keys.
